

Loop over each class, add class name and put together. Plot celltype specific genes
```{r}
#read in results
all_results = readRDS("all_results_var_partition_analysis.rds")
full_var_part_list = list()
for(i in 1:length(all_results)) {
  cur_class = names(all_results)[i]
  cur_df = all_results[[i]]$variance_df
  #only keep genes with strain higher than 10% explained var
  full_var_part_list[[cur_class]] = cur_df
}
full_var_part_df_strain = full_var_part_list %>% bind_rows()
```


```{r shared_high_strain_genes, echo=TRUE}
# Filter genes with >10% strain explained variance (strain > 0.1)
high_strain_genes <- full_var_part_df_strain %>%
  filter(strain > 0.1)
num_genes_per_class = high_strain_genes$class %>% table %>% as.data.frame.table() %>% rename("class" = ".") %>% rename("num_genes" = "Freq")
library(readr)
num_genes_per_class %>% write_csv("variance_partition_num_genes_per_class.csv")

num_classes_gene <- high_strain_genes %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarize(
    n_classes = n_distinct(class),
    class_names = paste(unique(class), collapse = ", ")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

write.csv(
  num_classes_gene, 
  "./variance_partition_high_strain_genes_and_classes.csv")
# Identify genes appearing in 3 or more classes
shared_genes_3plus <- num_classes_gene %>%
  filter(n_classes >= 3)

# Display the number of genes shared across 3 or more classes at >10% strain variance
cat("Number of genes with >10% strain variance explained found in 3 or more classes:", nrow(shared_genes_3plus), "\n")

# Optionally, plot number of genes binned by number of classes (for overview)
num_genes_variance_plot = ggplot(num_classes_gene, aes(x = n_classes)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#0571b0") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = after_stat(count)), 
    stat = 'count', 
    vjust = -0.25, 
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, max(num_classes_gene$n_classes), 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of classes gene appears in (> 10% strain variance)",
    y = "Number of genes",
    title = "Distribution of genes by number of classes with\n> 10% strain variance explained"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

ggsave(
  "./num_genes_shared_across_classes_variance_partition.pdf", 
  plot = num_genes_variance_plot, 
  width = 8, 
  height = 6
)
```

```{r}
# --- UpSet plot ---
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(stringr)

gene_class_matrix <- high_strain_genes %>%
  distinct(gene, class) %>%
  mutate(class = str_to_title(class)) %>%
  mutate(present = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = class, values_from = present, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene") %>%
  as.matrix()


```


```{r}
# 1. Build the full combination matrix
comb_mat_full <- make_comb_mat(gene_class_matrix, mode = "distinct")

# 2. Capture full set sizes BEFORE filtering (so they reflect true totals)
full_set_sizes <- set_size(comb_mat_full)

# 3. Filter to intersections > 1
comb_mat_filtered <- comb_mat_full[comb_size(comb_mat_full) > 1]

# 4. Reorder full_set_sizes to match the filtered matrix's set (row) order
aligned_set_sizes <- full_set_sizes[set_name(comb_mat_filtered)]

# 5. Build the left annotation using the aligned sizes
l_annot <- rowAnnotation(
  "Set Size" = anno_barplot(
    aligned_set_sizes,
    border = FALSE,
    gp = gpar(fill = "black"),
    width = unit(4, "cm"),
    ylim = c(0, 75),
    axis_param = list(
      direction = "reverse",
      at = c(0, 25, 50, 75),
      labels = c("0", "25", "50", "75")
    )
  ),
  annotation_name_side = "bottom"
)

# 6. Draw
upset_plot <- UpSet(
  comb_mat_filtered,
  comb_order = order(-comb_size(comb_mat_filtered)),
  set_order = order(-aligned_set_sizes),
  top_annotation = upset_top_annotation(comb_mat_filtered, add_numbers = TRUE),
  right_annotation = NULL,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  row_names_side = "left",
  left_annotation = l_annot,
  column_title = "Shared Variable Genes Across Classes"
)

pdf("./num_genes_shared_across_classes_upset.pdf", width = 10, height = 4)
draw(upset_plot)
dev.off()

draw(upset_plot)
```





Plot heatmap
```{r}
#only keep genes with strain higher than 20% explained var (strain > .2)
full_var_part_list = list()
for(i in 1:length(all_results)) {
  cur_class = names(all_results)[i]
  cur_df = all_results[[i]]$variance_df
  cur_df = cur_df %>% filter(strain > .2)
  full_var_part_list[[cur_class]] = cur_df
}
full_var_part_df_strain = full_var_part_list %>% bind_rows()



# --- 1. Identify and Filter Genes found in multiple classes ---
genes_to_remove <- full_var_part_df_strain %>%
  dplyr::count(gene) %>%
  filter(n > 1) %>%
  pull(gene)

top_genes_per_class <- full_var_part_df_strain %>%
  filter(!gene %in% genes_to_remove) %>%
  group_by(class) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = strain, n = 5) %>%
  ungroup()


# --- 2. Gather, Tidy, and Scale Data ---
tidy_data_list <- list()
for (cur_class in unique(top_genes_per_class$class)) {
  genes_to_plot <- top_genes_per_class %>%
    filter(class == cur_class) %>%
    pull(gene)
  
  if (length(genes_to_plot) == 0) next
  
  norm_exp <- all_results[[cur_class]][["norm_exp_data"]]
  meta <- all_results[[cur_class]][["pb_meta"]]
  genes_in_matrix <- intersect(genes_to_plot, rownames(norm_exp))
  
  if (length(genes_in_matrix) == 0) next
  
  class_tidy_data <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(norm_exp[genes_in_matrix, , drop = FALSE])) %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -gene, names_to = "animal_id", values_to = "expression") %>%
    left_join(meta %>% select(animal_id, strain, genotype, sex, age), by = "animal_id") %>%
    mutate(class = cur_class)
    
  tidy_data_list[[cur_class]] <- class_tidy_data
}

full_tidy_data <- bind_rows(tidy_data_list)

heatmap_tidy_data <- full_tidy_data %>%
  group_by(class, gene) %>%
  mutate(scaled_expression = scale(expression)[, 1]) %>%
  ungroup()


# --- 3. Determine Gene, Strain, and Animal Order ---
final_gene_order <- c()
for(cur_class in unique(heatmap_tidy_data$class)){
  class_data <- heatmap_tidy_data %>% filter(class == cur_class)
  
  if(length(unique(class_data$gene)) < 2) {
      class_gene_order <- unique(class_data$gene)
  } else {
      class_matrix <- class_data %>%
        select(gene, animal_id, scaled_expression) %>%
        pivot_wider(names_from = animal_id, values_from = scaled_expression) %>%
        column_to_rownames("gene")
    #  class_matrix[is.na(class_matrix)] <- 0 
      hclust_result <- hclust(dist(class_matrix))
      class_gene_order <- hclust_result$labels[hclust_result$order]
  }
  final_gene_order <- c(final_gene_order, class_gene_order)
}

strain_order_df <- heatmap_tidy_data %>%
  group_by(strain, gene) %>%
  summarise(mean_scaled_expression = mean(scaled_expression, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')

strain_cluster_matrix <- strain_order_df %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = gene, values_from = mean_scaled_expression) %>%
  column_to_rownames("strain")

#strain_cluster_matrix[is.na(strain_cluster_matrix)] <- 0
strain_hclust <- hclust(dist(strain_cluster_matrix))
strain_order <- strain_hclust$labels[strain_hclust$order]
strain_order <- c("B6", setdiff(strain_order, "B6"))
# 
# animal_order <- heatmap_tidy_data %>%
#   select(animal_id, strain) %>%
#   distinct() %>%
#   arrange(factor(strain, levels = strain_order), animal_id) %>%
#   pull(animal_id) %>%
#   unique()

animal_order <- heatmap_tidy_data %>%
  select(animal_id, strain, sex, age, genotype) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(factor(strain, levels = strain_order), sex, age, genotype, animal_id) %>%
  pull(animal_id) %>%
  unique()

heatmap_tidy_data$gene <- factor(heatmap_tidy_data$gene, levels = rev(final_gene_order))
heatmap_tidy_data$strain <- factor(heatmap_tidy_data$strain, levels = strain_order)
heatmap_tidy_data$animal_id <- factor(heatmap_tidy_data$animal_id, levels = animal_order)
```

Split
```{r}
# --- 4. Create Annotation and Heatmap Plots ---

# Define the Okabe-Ito color palette
okabe_ito_palette <- c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442", "#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7")

# Create the annotation data frame
annotation_long <- heatmap_tidy_data %>%
  select(animal_id, strain, genotype, sex, age) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c("genotype", "sex", "age"),
    names_to = "category",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    animal_id = factor(animal_id, levels = animal_order),
    strain = factor(strain, levels = strain_order),
    category = factor(category, levels = c("genotype", "sex", "age"))
  )

# Create the annotation plot
annotation_plot <- ggplot(annotation_long, aes(x = animal_id, y = category, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_grid(~ strain, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = okabe_ito_palette,
    guide = guide_legend(title.position = "top", keywidth = 0.5, keyheight = 0.5)
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(c("sex", "age", "genotype"))) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    strip.text.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14,face = "bold"),
    # MODIFIED: Reduced spacing between strains
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.1, "lines")
  ) +
  labs(fill = NULL)

library(tidyverse)
heatmap_tidy_data$class = str_to_title(heatmap_tidy_data$class)
# Create the main heatmap plot
heatmap_plot <- ggplot(heatmap_tidy_data, aes(x = animal_id, y = gene, fill = scaled_expression)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  facet_grid(class ~ strain, scales = "free", space = "free", switch = "both") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#0571b0", 
    mid = "white",
    high = "#ca0020",
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "Scaled \nExpression \n(Z-score)"
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold", size = 14),
    strip.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", angle = 0, hjust = .25, size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    # MODIFIED: Reduced spacing between strains
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.1, "lines")
  )


# --- 5. Combine Plots and Save ---
combined_plot <- annotation_plot / heatmap_plot +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 7), guides = "collect")

ggsave(
  "./celltype_specific_strain_genes_with_full_annotation.pdf", 
  plot = combined_plot, 
  width = 20, 
  height = 10
)
```
